title: Flow Vibing: every prototype is also a flow
bodyText: A canvas tool where Claude answers a brief by writing a Design Spec and the screens together, so the flow chart and the running prototype are two readings of the same files. Step through the four attributes that make a plain HTML screen runnable, flip between the two views, and see which screens a set of changes actually rewrites.
whatThisProves: I design the contract a tool runs on, not just its screens — a four-attribute interface that lets a flow chart and a working prototype stay the same artifact.
